jobs.description:
Reporting directly to the Product Development Leader, you will be responsible for the development and optimization of new products within the RV business line. This includes product categories such as awnings, bike racks, steps, and soft goods (tents and panels).

 
• 
You lead the development of new products from concept through to industrialization, ensuring alignment with both external requirements and internal quality standards.

 
• 
You identify opportunities for product improvements, focusing on functionality, performance, and quality.

 
• 
You work in accordance with the Project System, following a structured stage-gate process.

 
• 
You act as the technical point of contact for suppliers, refining designs and ensuring manufacturability.

 
• 
You provide technical support to internal and external stakeholders, including sales, product management, production, and process engineering.

 
• 
You take ownership of product data accuracy and integrity within the PLM system.

 
• 
You manage all phases of new product development projects, from concept creation and detailed design to prototyping, testing, and production launch.

 
• 
You report directly to the Product Development Leader.

 
• 
You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Design (Electromechanics) or have equivalent professional experience.

 
• 
You bring around 10 years of relevant experience in product development within a similar role.

 
• 
You are a strong communicator and presenter, able to confidently pitch ideas to senior stakeholders.

 
• 
You have solid language skills: fluent Dutch, good English, and basic knowledge of French and German.

 
• 
You are highly skilled in industrial product and/or soft goods design; knowledge of electronics is considered a plus.

 
• 
You have strong proficiency in 3D CAD; experience with SolidWorks is a strong advantage.

 
• 
You take full responsibility for your projects, combining an entrepreneurial mindset with structured execution.

 
• 
You are proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.).

 
• 
You combine creative, conceptual thinking with a strong analytical approach.

 
• 
You naturally align with and represent the brand identity and active lifestyle values.

As part of the Product Development Compliance team, you ensure that both new and existing products are tested, verified, and approved in accordance with the strict requirements. You define and maintain test plans, evaluate test results, and remain actively involved in technical product improvements throughout the development process. In this role, you safeguard and confirm the technical compliance of all products within the RV business line, including awnings, bike racks, steps, and soft goods (tents and panels).

Role and tasks

 
• 
You establish and maintain test procedures, ensuring full alignment with the Test Code.

 
• 
You develop and/or execute the required tests to demonstrate safety and conformity of components and finished products.

 
• 
You perform testing on prototypes and existing products with the aim of improving quality, and provide technical input for product improvements based on test outcomes.

 
• 
You define and manage test plans within product development projects.

 
• 
You monitor incoming test requests and coordinate planning accordingly.

 
• 
You own the RV test center and drive continuous improvements to ensure compliance with defined procedures and testing standards. You also define and justify required investments to the Product Development Leader.

 
• 
You act as the main point of contact for the Test Center and build strong working relationships with external laboratories and knowledge centers.

 
• 
You plan and coordinate testing activities both within the Test Center and with external partners.

 
• 
You provide technical support to internal stakeholders such as sales, product management, production, and process engineering.

 
• 
You manage and coordinate projects related to the responsibilities above.

 
• 
You ensure all test reports are properly stored and accessible within the PLM system.

 
• 
You stay up to date with relevant standards and ensure test methods remain current and compliant.

 
• 
You are an active member of the compliance team.

 
• 
You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in (Electro-)mechanics or a related technical field.

 
• 
You have strong technical expertise and are a natural problem solver.

 
• 
You are creative in designing and developing new test methods.

 
• 
You are hands-on and take full ownership of your work.

 
• 
You have strong spatial awareness and are comfortable working with technical drawings.

 
• 
You have a basic understanding of electronics (e.g. motors, control units, etc.).

 
• 
You are an effective communicator, able to collaborate across teams.

 
• 
You have strong language skills: fluent Dutch, good English, and basic knowledge of French and German.

 
• 
You enjoy hands-on testing, including dismantling and destructively testing products.

 
• 
You take full responsibility for your projects, combining entrepreneurial drive with a structured approach.

 
• 
You work in a precise, organized, and methodical way.

 
• 
You are proficient in Microsoft Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.).

 
• 
You are a creative and conceptual thinker with a strong analytical mindset.

 
• 
Knowledge of SolidWorks is considered an advantage.

 
• 
Experience with simulation software (FEM) is a plus.

 
• 
You naturally embody and represent the brand identity and active lifestyle values.

• A hands-on mentality and strong attention to detail

The Office Manager ensures the smooth daily operation of the shopping centre through administrative management, coordination with internal teams and tenants, and professional reception of visitors. They support management with reporting, agenda management and information handling, while maintaining accurate records and ensuring efficient communication across the site.

 

Bedrijfsomschrijving

The employer is a dynamic and growing organisation operating within a modern commercial and operational environment. Bringing together various services, activities and partners on one site, the company relies on strong internal coordination to ensure smooth day‑to‑day functioning. To support this mission, it is looking for an Office Manager who will play a key role in the operational and administrative management of the location.

 

Omschrijving

The Office Manager acts as a central point of coordination for the Technical Director and supports various operational teams across the shopping centre.

Administrative Management
 She/he manages internal and external communications, prepares and reviews documents, maintains updated tenant information, circulates weekly footfall data to the Landlord, the Property Manager and the internal team, and organises meetings and conferences. She/he also manages agendas, appointments and administrative workflows.

Coordination
 She/he collaborates closely with internal departments, external partners and tenants to ensure fluid communication and the smooth running of ongoing projects. Responsibilities include drafting meeting minutes, monitoring deadlines, managing office supplies, and overseeing the Info Desk schedule, orders and administrative tasks, including basic support with SUMUP-related matters.

Reception & Customer Relations
 As a representative of the shopping centre, she/he welcomes visitors, partners and clients in a warm and professional manner and provides clear, accurate information regarding the centre's services and activities.

Information Management
 She/he maintains all records, files and databases, ensures confidentiality and data security, oversees the publication and updates of House Rules on Chainels and manages internal communication such as "What's Up" on Chainels.

Support to Management
 She/he assists the Facility Manager with follow‑up on files such as security and insurance, prepares ad hoc reports and summaries to support decision‑making and provides occasional support to the marketing team when needed.

 

The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism, discretion and strong organisational abilities.

Key criteria include:

• A flexible and hands‑on approach.
• A degree in Business Administration, Secretarial Studies or a related field.
• Previous experience in an Executive Assistant, Office Manager or similar role; experience in a shopping‑centre environment is a strong asset.
• Excellent organisational, prioritisation and time‑management skills.
• Strong proficiency in MS Office and digital tools.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work autonomously, anticipate needs and take initiative.
• High level of discretion and a proactive mindset.
• Fluency in French, Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: Freelance Project Manager Warehouse - Brownfield Project
jobs.description:
Our client is a rapidly expanding international consumer goods company strengthening its footprint across Central & Eastern Europe. To support this growth, they are launching a new warehouse and transport platform in the Czech Republic that will serve the entire CEE region.

Jobomschrijving

As a Freelance Project Manager Warehouse your responsibilities are:

• Participate in the final tender and negotiation phase to select and contract the warehouse partner in the Czech Republic.
• Define and implement warehouse operating procedures (SOPs) together with the selected 3PL.
• Prepare the dedicated warehouse areas and align operational ways of working with the logistics partner.
• Establish KPI tracking, governance routines, and daily/weekly/monthly performance reviews.
• Set up the transport network for parcel and pallet flows across all Central & Eastern European countries.
• Negotiate with transport providers and manage commercial and operational discussions.
• Work closely with the IT team on the integration between the company ERP (Infor M3) and the 3PL WMS platform.
• Monitor warehouse and transport performance, customer service levels, stock accuracy, inbound/outbound activities, and delivery lead times.
• Analyze operational data and provide KPI reporting to management.
• Support business growth by identifying service and logistics optimization opportunities.
• Prepare the operational handover to the future Logistics Manager after the stabilization phase.

A successful Freelance Project Manager Warehouse should have:

• Proven experience managing warehouse setup, 3PL implementation, or logistics transformation projects in an international environment.
• Strong background in warehousing and transport operations.
• Experience running RFP/RFQ processes and negotiating with logistics providers.
• Knowledge of consumer goods, retail fashion, B2B distribution, or e-commerce logistics is a strong advantage.
• Fluent Czech and English are mandatory.
